name: TextTL
tagline: Local plain text file timeline memo tool
blurb: TextTL is SNS like app that store each post to individual text files.
description:
TextTL is SNS like app that store each post to individual text files.

You can sync these files by Syncthing or any other sync tool and process it in PC.
